claim: The Vps4 structures are most consistent with binding of the primary strand N-terminal residues at the A-end of the Vps4 helix and C-terminal residues at the E-end.
source: Although it is not yet definitively resolved, the Vps4 structures are most consistent with binding of the primary strand N-terminal residues at the A-end of the Vps4 helix and C-terminal residues at the E-end.
evidence: This is an inference based on the structural data, though not definitively resolved.

claim: This orientation is consistent with the biological role of Vps4 in translocating toward the ESCRT-III N-terminal domain.
source: This orientation is consistent with the biological role of Vps4 in translocating toward the ESCRT-III N-terminal domain
evidence: This is an inference based on the known biological function of Vps4.

claim: Other AAA+ ATPases apparently translocate their protein substrates in the opposite direction (N-to-C).
source: but other AAA+ ATPases apparently translocate their protein substrates in the opposite direction (N-to-C) (Alfieri et al., 2018; Puchades et al., 2017)
evidence: Supported by citations to published studies.

claim: Some AAA+ ATPases can translocate substrates in either direction.
source: or in either direction (Augustyniak and Kay, 2018)
evidence: Supported by citation to published study.

claim: The same mechanism of translocation could be applied to substrates bound with their primary strand in either orientation because side chains make a major contribution to binding, and forward and reversed β-strands can superimpose their Cα atoms and side chains.
source: Indeed, the same mechanism of translocation could be applied to substrates bound with their primary strand in either orientation because side chains make a major contribution to binding, and forward and reversed β-strands can superimpose their Cα atoms and side chains.

claim: The structures suggest that substrates might bind the AAA+ pore in a hairpin conformation that is translocated in both the N-to-C and C-to-N directions at the same time.

claim: Contexts in which translocation of two polypeptide chains through a AAA+ ATPase pore might be functionally important include the initiation of translocation from an internal loop, crosslinked substrates, and ubiquitin adducts.
source: Contexts in which translocation of two polypeptide chains through a AAA+ ATPase pore might be functionally important include the initiation of translocation from an internal loop, crosslinked substrates, and ubiquitin adducts, as have been indicated for the proteasome (Kraut and Matouschek, 2011; Lee et al., 2002; Shabek and Ciechanover, 2010), Cdc48 (Bodnar and Rapoport, 2017), and ClpX (Burton et al., 2001)
evidence: This is speculation supported by citations to published studies showing these substrates can be processed.

claim: The model for simultaneous translocation of two polypeptide chains through the pore of a AAA+ ATPases will cause them to rotate with respect to each other, with one complete rotation anticipated for every 12 residues of primary strand translocated.
source: As shown in these animations, the model for simultaneous translocation of two polypeptide chains through the pore of a AAA+ ATPases will cause them to rotate with respect to each other, with one complete rotation anticipated for every 12 residues of primary strand translocated.
evidence: This is an inference based on the structural model and geometry of the helical arrangement.

claim: Successive dipeptides of the primary strand bind successive Vps4 subunits, which are rotated 60° with respect to each other, at the lining of the pore, while the secondary strand continually lies along the center of the pore.
source: This is because successive dipeptides of the primary strand bind successive Vps4 subunits, which are rotated 60° with respect to each other, at the lining of the pore, while the secondary strand continually lies along the center of the pore.
evidence: This is an inference based on the structural model.

claim: The twist introduced to the substrate when long stretches of double chains are translocated might be resolved by relative rotation of the AAA+ ATPase or by periodically switching which strand engages the pore loops and which lies along the open channel.
source: The twist that this introduces to the substrate when long stretches of double chains are translocated might be resolved by relative rotation of the AAA+ ATPase or by periodically switching which strand engages the pore loops and which lies along the open channel.
evidence: This is speculation about how the twist might be resolved.

claim: The extent to which simultaneous binding and translocation of two polypeptide chains or a polypeptide with some other adduct actually occurs for the various different AAA+ ATPases remains to be determined.
source: The extent to which simultaneous binding and translocation of two polypeptide chains or a polypeptide with some other adduct actually occurs for the various different AAA+ ATPases remains to be determined.

source: An N-terminal cysteine was included in F30 and FF30, and versions of these peptides were also synthesized with a C-terminal hydrazide to facilitate synthesis of the circular cF30 and cFF30 peptides

source: which are identical to F30 and FF30 except for cyclization through a peptide bond between the N and C terminal residues (Figure 1)

source: The only difference was a 10-fold higher concentration of Vta1VSL, which was increased because the earlier cryo-EM reconstructions showed low Vta1VSL occupancy.

claim: Spotiton was used to prepare the cFF30 grids.
source: cFF30 complex samples were vitrified using the Spotiton robot as described (Dandey et al., 2018; Jain et al., 2012; Razinkov et al., 2016)
evidence: This describes the method used for grid preparation.

claim: The time between sample application to the grid and plunging into liquid ethane (spot-to-plunge time) was ~145 ms for Spotiton.
source: The time between sample application to the grid and plunging into liquid ethane (spot-to-plunge time) was ~145 ms.
evidence: This describes a technical parameter of the Spotiton method.

claim: Under Spotiton conditions, evaporation is estimated to be 300 Å/s.
source: Under these conditions, evaporation is estimated to be 300 Å/s.
evidence: This describes a technical parameter of the Spotiton method.

claim: The microscope was operated at 300 kV at a nominal magnification of 130,000x, with a calibrated pixel size of 1.09 Å.
source: the microscope was operated at 300 kV at a nominal magnification of 130,000x, with a calibrated pixel size of 1.09 Å
evidence: This describes technical parameters of the cryo-EM data collection.

claim: Exposure was set to 10 s (50 frames/movie, detector operated at counting mode), for a total dose of 76.68 e–/Å2 with a defocus range of 1.6 to 2.2 µm.
source: Exposure was set to 10 s (50 frames/movie, detector operated at counting mode), for a total dose of 76.68 e–/Å2 with a defocus range of 1.6 to 2.2 µm.
evidence: This describes technical parameters of the cryo-EM data collection.

claim: A total of 2838 (cF30) and 1855 (cFF30) dose-weighted sums were used for all subsequent image processing steps.
source: A total of 2838 (cF30) and 1855 (cFF30) dose-weighted sums were used for all subsequent image processing steps.
evidence: This describes the number of micrographs used for image processing.

claim: 529,807 (cF30) and 356,705 (cFF30) particles were extracted and used as input for full CTF-corrected image processing.
source: 529,807 (cF30) and 356,705 (cFF30) particles were extracted and used as input for full CTF-corrected image processing.
evidence: This describes the number of particles used for image processing.

claim: After multiple rounds of 2D classification in RELION, 204,636 (cF30) and 155,900 (cFF30) particles were retained.
source: After multiple rounds of 2D classification in RELION (RRID:SCR_016274) (Scheres, 2012), 204,636 (cF30) and 155,900 (cFF30) particles were retained
evidence: This describes the results of 2D classification.

claim: After 3D classification, 157,775 (cF30) and 144,776 (cFF30) particles were used for RELION auto-refinement.
source: After 3D classification, 157,775 (cF30) and 144,776 (cFF30) particles were used for RELION (RRID:SCR_016274) auto-refinement (Scheres, 2012)
evidence: This describes the results of 3D classification.

claim: RELION auto-refinement generated an ~4.5 Å density map of the Hcp1-Vps4 fusion complex based on the gold-standard FSC criterion.
source: which in each case generated an ~4.5 Å density map of the Hcp1-Vps4 fusion complex based on the gold-standard FSC criterion
evidence: This describes the resolution of the initial reconstruction.

claim: Signal subtraction of Hcp1 densities was performed to improve the resolution of Vps4.
source: To improve the resolution of Vps4, we performed signal subtraction of Hcp1 densities, as described (Bai et al., 2015; Monroe et al., 2017)
evidence: This describes a methodological approach used in image processing.

claim: For the cF30 complex dataset, an additional round of 3D classification post-Hcp1-subtraction assigned 92,704 particles into a single class with high-resolution Vps4 features.
source: For the cF30 complex dataset, an additional round of 3D classification post-Hcp1-subtraction assigned 92,704 particles into a single class with high-resolution Vps4 features.
evidence: This describes the results of 3D classification after signal subtraction.

claim: These 92,704 particles from cF30 were used for a final round of RELION auto-refinement, producing a 3.8 Å resolution density map of Vps4.
source: These particles were used for a final round of RELION (RRID:SCR_016274) auto-refinement, producing a 3.8 Å resolution density map of Vps4.
evidence: This describes the final resolution achieved for the cF30 dataset.

claim: For the cFF30 complex dataset, the Hcp1-subtracted dataset was used for RELION auto-refinement without further classification, producing a 4.0 Å resolution density map.
source: For the cFF30 complex dataset, the Hcp1-subtracted dataset was used for RELION (RRID:SCR_016274) auto-refinement without further classification, producing a 4.0 Å resolution density map.
evidence: This describes the final resolution achieved for the cFF30 dataset.

claim: The merged dataset comprised a total of 237,480 particles (92,704 from cF30 complex, 144,776 from the cFF30 complex).
source: The merged dataset comprised a total of 237,480 particles (92,704 from cF30 complex, 144,776 from the cFF30 complex).
evidence: This describes the number of particles in the combined dataset.

claim: B-factor sharpening of −157 Å2 was applied to the final 3.56 Å map.
source: B-factor sharpening of −157 Å2 was applied to the final 3.56 Å map using an automated procedure in RELION (RRID:SCR_016274) postprocessing (Rosenthal and Henderson, 2003)

claim: Subunit F was poorly resolved due to its relative flexibility.
source: As observed in our previous structures of Vps4 bound to linear peptides, subunit F was poorly resolved due to its relative flexibility (Monroe et al., 2017)
evidence: This is an observation from the cryo-EM map, consistent with previous structures.

claim: Focused 3D classification was performed by applying a spherical mask over subunit F density.
source: We therefore performed focused 3D classification by applying a spherical mask over subunit F density (Figure 2—figure supplement 4)
evidence: This describes a methodological approach used in image processing.

claim: Classification of subunit F led to three classes with ordered density and three classes with disordered density.
source: Classification was performed without re-alignment (i.e., using the --skip_align flag in RELION, K = 6), leading to three classes with ordered density and three classes with disordered density (Figure 2—figure supplement 5)

claim: 24,778 particles from the cFF30 dataset were sorted into a single class that showed Vta1VSL densities at all six Vps4 interfaces.
source: 24,778 particles from the cFF30 dataset were sorted into a single class that showed Vta1VSL densities at all six Vps4 interfaces.
evidence: This describes the results of focused classification for Vta1VSL.

claim: These 24,778 particles were used for RELION 3D auto-refinement, resulting in a 4.4 Å resolution reconstruction.
source: These particles were used for RELION 3D auto-refinement, resulting in a 4.4 Å resolution reconstruction.
evidence: This describes the resolution achieved for the Vta1VSL-bound structure.

claim: The refined model comprising the Vps4 ATPase domains of subunits A-E and the cyclic peptide is accessible via the PDB (PDB ID: 6NDY) together with the 3.6 Å map (EMDB Accession Number EMD-0443).
source: The refined model comprising the Vps4 ATPase domains of subunits A-E and the cyclic peptide is accessible via the PDB (RRID: SCR_012820; PDB ID: 6NDY) together with the 3.6 Å map from the combined dataset (RRID: SCR_003207, EMDB Accession Number EMD-0443).
evidence: This describes the data deposition.

claim: The complete model, including regions not subjected to atomic refinement such as the 12 Vta1VSL domains and subunit F, is available via the PDB (PDB ID: 6OO2), together with the map containing Vta1VSL densities at all six Vps4 interfaces (EMDB Accession Number EMD-20142).
source: The complete model, including regions not subjected to atomic refinement such as the 12 Vta1VSL domains and subunit F, is also available via the PDB (PDB ID: 6OO2), together with the map containing Vta1VSL densities at all six Vps4 interfaces (RRID: SCR_003207, EMDB Accession Number EMD-20142).
